tasks.subject: Task 6: EmblemService rules
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One service grants emblems at login and when marks are added, runs the record sweep, handles staff give/take and the player's choice, builds the emblem book, and feeds the world list's emblem art.

**Files:**
- Create: `SERVER/Chaos/Services/Emblems/EmblemService.cs`
- Modify: `SERVER/Chaos/Services/MapperProfiles/AislingMapperProfile.cs` (`WorldListMemberInfo` map)
- Test: `SERVER/Tests/Chaos.Tests/Emblems/EmblemServiceTests.cs`
- Test: `SERVER/Tests/Chaos.Tests/AislingMapperProfileTests.cs` (one new test)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Login grants every legend-mark emblem the player already qualifies for, with a message, and shows the first one when the cell is empty
- [ ] Adding a mark while online grants its emblem; a second emblem doesn't replace the shown one
- [ ] An expiring emblem counts its duration from the grant, reads as not owned once expired, and is not granted again at the next login
- [ ] `Take` revokes and blocks re-grant; `Give` clears that and sets a fresh duration; neither works on record emblems or unknown keys
- [ ] The sweep moves a record to the new first place, messages both players, shows it for the winner if their cell is empty, and clears it for the loser
- [ ] The book lists owned then locked emblems, leaves out unowned secret ones, and fills granted, seconds left and holder
- [ ] `HandleChoice` ignores keys the player doesn't own, and an empty key hides
- [ ] The world list's `EmblemArt` comes from `Emblems.ShownArtAt`

**Verify:** from SERVER: `dotnet run --project Tests/Chaos.Tests/Chaos.Tests.csproj -- --no-ansi --treenode-filter "/*/*/EmblemServiceTests/*"` and `…"/*/*/AislingMapperProfileTests/*"` → all pass
